target.statement: RIFormer-S12 with identity mapping and soft distillation without labels achieves 74.05% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K (120 epochs).

compute.basis: Training a 12M-parameter model for 120 epochs on ImageNet-1K requires GPU acceleration; on CPU it would take days, so the target is not feasible on a normal laptop within a few hours.

blockers: No code or model weights released
Requires training on ImageNet-1K (1.2M images) for 120 epochs
Needs a pre-trained teacher model (GFNet-H-B) for distillation
Requires GPU for reasonable training time
title: RIFormer: Keep Your Vision Backbone Effective While Removing Token Mixer
